**主题：边关摆烂指南**

视觉主体：一位身穿明光铠甲的古代边将，头戴战盔歪斜，慵懒地瘫靠在烽火台垛口上，一手举着酒壶，一手比"OK"手势，表情享受闭眼微笑，身后狼烟袅袅升起却无人理会。背景为大漠孤烟、残阳如血、城墙绵延，远处敌军骑兵隐约可见。

风格：国潮工笔重彩+现代漫画夸张表情，色彩以赭石、朱砂、鎏金为主调，狼烟用流动水墨晕染，整体画面有敦煌壁画的厚重肌理感，人物面部带Q版幽默感。

文字：主标题"边关摆烂指南"（粗犷毛笔飞白体，朱砂红），副标语"烽火连天，我先躺了"（小篆风格，金色描边），角落盖一方红色闲章"躺赢"。

构图：竖版，人物居中偏下，上方留白给狼烟与天空，文字横排于顶部。

Style: Chinese national-trend meticulous heavy-color illustration blended with modern comic exaggeration. The image is a vertical poster dominated by ochre, cinnabar red, and gilded gold tones, with the texture of aged Dunhuang mural pigment across cracked plaster-like surfaces. At the top, large horizontal brush-calligraphy text reads "边关摆烂指南" in rough flying-white cinnabar red strokes, occupying most of the upper width against smoky beige sky. Beneath it, smaller centered slogan text reads "烽火连天，我先躺了" in small-seal-style characters outlined in warm gold. In the upper-right corner, a square red seal stamp contains the two-character mark "躺赢", arranged like a traditional carved chop inside a double-line border. Behind the typography, thick wolf smoke rises in flowing ink-wash plumes from burning beacon fires, drifting upward through the empty sky area without interrupting readability.

The central visual subject sits slightly below center on the battlement parapet of an ancient frontier watchtower. He is an East Asian male border general, rendered as a humorous chibi-like warrior with exaggerated facial proportions, closed smiling eyes, relaxed cheeks, and a deeply content expression. His skin tone is warm tan under sunset light; his face has rounded features, subtle cheek shading, dark brows partly hidden beneath the helmet brim, and no visible moustache or beard. He wears ornate Mingguang armor made of dark bronze-black plates with raised gold trim, engraved swirling patterns, layered shoulder guards, arm bands, knee guards, greaves, and chainmail textures at joints and sleeves. A deep burgundy-red cloak drapes behind him over the stone wall, adding weight and contrast to the metallic armor. His helmet tilts lazily sideways rather than sitting ceremonially straight; it has a broad black-gold crown plate, embossed ornamentation, side flaps, and tall horsehair plume feathers sweeping backward toward the right. One hand holds a round wine flask near chest height, its surface catching golden highlights, while the other forms an OK gesture beside his head. His posture is intentionally slack and comedic: legs stretched forward along the parapet, torso leaning back into the垛口, shoulders dropped, and body language suggesting he ignores the war around him.

Behind him, the background opens into a vast desert frontier battlefield at sunset. Low sun glows near the horizon in saturated orange-red light, casting long shadows across sand-colored ground and stone fortifications. Smoke columns rise from multiple beacon stations, painted as semi-transparent gray-brown ink clouds that merge with the parchment-textured sky. Distant enemy cavalry appears faintly on the lower-left horizon as tiny silhouettes with horses, flags, and spears, deliberately blurred and subordinate to the foreground figure. Long city walls stretch horizontally across the middle distance, their broken towers and ramparts softened by haze. The overall composition leaves generous negative space above for smoke and calligraphy, while the character anchors the lower half with oversized armor detail and playful relaxation.

Audio layer (integrated for video generation): Warm ambient wind whistles across the dry frontier landscape, mixed with distant drum beats, muted horn calls, and scattered marching sounds from the far-off troops. Fires burn steadily behind the tower, producing low crackling flames and hot ember pops, while ash and sparks drift upward in soft irregular bursts. The sound design stays atmospheric rather than loud, supporting the satire of a calm soldier ignoring surrounding chaos.
